provenance.prior_role_context_disclosed: This same agent previously performed the separate contact-sound repair verification. That knowledge cannot be erased. This judging role freshly viewed the required current and historical images and formed its craft scores from current pixels, text and measurement evidence, without reading another judge or a new change brief.

axes.name: Hook & retention
axes.rationale: The native first frame immediately presents a large outlined pen with distinct report and draft outputs. The opening promise eventually pays through visible ink and a changed pen state, and the cap supplies a separate physical callback. The 6.54 to 37.8-second announcement and ownership stretch is less compelling, relying on cabinet movement and stacked source labels. Around 80seconds the cap adds action but little new informational pressure. Retention is competent with a real second-minute progression, not sustained dramatic urgency.

axes.name: Illustration craft & detail
axes.rationale: The pen has a bright clip, beveled cap rim, shaded barrel, collar and split nib. The sleeve includes cuff detail and comparable form shading; paper tabs, folded corners and shaded desk edges carry the same ink language. This is good execution within the flat-vector style. Finish remains uneven because the broad cabinet/source-wall planes and lamp are plainer than the pen. Semi-transparent hand and sleeve overlays at 56.5, 81 and 116.5 seconds soften physical handling and create visible ghosting.

axes.name: Motion & animation craft
axes.rationale: Consecutive current strips show actual cap separation, retrieval and rotation, report and source-tab movement, nib contact with growing ink, lift and a retained mark. These are object state changes, beyond camera motion. The grip itself changes little while entire forearms translate or rotate. Report examination has modest articulation and many stretches rely on whole-layout sway. The ghosted hand transitions make contact moments less crisp. The score remains above merely mechanical motion and below a fully articulated performance.

axes.name: Composition & staging
axes.rationale: The announcement cabinet, email intake aisle, rule cutaway, drafting table, tool cup and overhead review desk are distinct visible arrangements. Output silhouettes and captions remain readable in the portrait frames, and crop checks separately pass. Repeated centered label stacks above a middle-screen object make the rooms compositionally similar; the large upper cream area reduces perceived scene scale. At 97.5 seconds the lamp shade overlaps the rear pen and draft tab, while the nib and ink remain visible. This is minor crowding, not an obscured action.

axes.name: Color & grade
axes.rationale: Cream paper, copper work surfaces, petrol cabinetry, nickel highlights and the oxblood pen form a coherent office palette with clear dark-ink contrast and restrained gradients. The copper workspace differs from September 12 lilac/citron and September 11 clinic/proof staging. Cream, green and berry-family accents still resemble the September 11 anchor, so freshness is modest. No exact recent palette repeat or unexplained default-blue treatment is observed.

axes.name: Typography & captions
axes.rationale: The display-title and monospaced label system is consistent and readable. Captions remain high contrast at the sheet scale; the final question fits in three lines. Native 125 and 130-second frames show the sources, composer and license, with the latter frame beginning the planned fade after the verified ten-second readable window. Type is predominantly static stacked plates. PREBUILT LOGIC becomes faint during the 56.5-second cap transition, but its preceding visible hold and simultaneous caption preserve the information.

axes.name: Sound design & mix
axes.rationale: This score uses current encoded measurements and event evidence, with no human-listening claim. The master measures -14.33 LUFS, -2.74 dBTP and 7.4 LU LRA. The current quality report detects 29 audible events from 40 motivated cues and a measured bed dip before the button. The actual ledger places the cap event at 81.976 seconds beside the seated cap visible in the contact strip, and the mix has differentiated paper, metal, wood and clip events. Mining by Moonlight, Kevin MacLeod and CC BY 4.0 are legibly credited. This supports a layered, technically compliant mix; subjective musical fit, timbral balance and conversational delivery are not established by these measurements.

axes.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
axes.rationale: The current captioned frames and strips pair the DORA subject token, API retrieval and rules with their narration, then make a separate Jumpstarter room for generated draft sections. Report examination and the nib-made refinement mark land during the corresponding human-work narration. The permanent mark survives to the comparison and closing pen return. The aligned read ends at 118.54 seconds. The pen action is a watchable recurring device, but ownership exposition and repeated preparation/finishing statements soften entertainment momentum.

axes.name: Accuracy & sourcing
axes.rationale: The exact current narration, post, visible labels and verified claims preserve the September 11 company announcement versus earlier AWS Army procurement work. DORA uses retrieval and prebuilt logic; the separate Jumpstarter tools use language models. Review/determination and refinement/approval remain professional responsibilities. Optional duration, dollar and labor totals are absent. The Alaska-return absence is scoped to this announcement. The illustrative workflow is labeled. The source ceiling is the AWS partner case study and its company reproduction, not two independent outcome investigations; the film does not claim independently verified Wingman productivity.

axes.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
axes.rationale: KGS and Koniag are named corporate entities, and the Kodiak-region connection is plainly stated. Ordinary faceless office hands do not personify Native people or introduce cultural props, unverified language or generic Tribal framing. The treatment credits useful preparation without converting Army efficiencies into Alaska jobs, revenue or shareholder distributions. The Alaska connection is corporate ownership, not a demonstrated local deployment, and that limitation is accurately preserved.

axes.name: Writing & post quality
axes.rationale: The current 204-word narration and 1506-character LinkedIn post explain a concrete preparation-versus-professional-decision distinction. The post puts preparation credit immediately below its hook, uses September 11th, attributes both company and AWS accounts, and ends with a practical report/draft question. Four hashtags follow the Dispatch-specific rule. No prohibited public-prose dash, colon, semicolon, formal cannot or invented numeric claim appears. Repetition of preparation and finishing in late narration and labels slightly blunts the button.

regrade_calibration.standard: Same within-style scale as revision 1. Current visual, writing and source evidence supports the same ten non-sound scores. Sound rises only 0.1 from current audible-event and exact event-timing evidence. This is not a bonus for completing a repair or a new scoring standard.

evidence_viewed.historical_calibration: All five named September 11 anchor images were freshly viewed. Whole-film medians calibrate the scale only. Current pen materials are comparably resolved, while the current report action and repeat centered plate layouts remain below exceptional motion/staging.

limitations: Visual judgment uses six whole-film sheets, eight required consecutive strips, eleven native frames and four additional beat strips. It is not uninterrupted real-time playback or visual inspection of every frame.
No human listening was performed. Sound taste is bounded by current encoded loudness/dynamics, measured event coverage, exact event timing, the voice report and visible music credits.

The current isolated-stem and encoded-residual verification was a separate completed role. It does not establish subjective musical fit, and weaker residual matches must not be described as isolated final-mix peaks.
Accuracy was checked against the supplied current independently verified findings, primary-source claim records and exact public copy. This panel pass did not repeat the live source fetch.
Only the current 9:16 master is aesthetically scored. Square compliance comes from mechanical checks.
Required storyboard and voice inputs contain production-history metadata. Those notes were not used as evidence of successful rendering or as grounds for score changes.
Prior role knowledge is disclosed above; this is not represented as a memoryless blind judge. No other current panel card was read.
